# Ambrotype

> Ambrotype is a free, open-source Lightroom alternative (Rust workspace) whose engine renders Lightroom / Camera Raw presets and XMP sidecars. Photos are edited non-destructively through Camera Raw (crs:) settings. AI assistants and scripts drive it through the `amb` CLI with validated, undoable commands (`amb edit`), never by editing pixels or sidecars by hand.

## Docs for AI clients

- [Core card](docs/ai/core.md): read first. The compact edit syntax (`amb do PHOTO "exp=+0.5 con+=10"`) and the most used settings with ranges, in a few hundred tokens. `amb ref GROUP` prints one group's settings; `amb stats PHOTO` measures a photo instead of rendering a picture; `amb match PHOTO REF.jpg` finds the settings for a reference look.
- [AI and scripting guide](docs/ai/README.md): how to inspect, edit (`amb edit --commands`, with `--dry-run`), query, render previews and apply presets; the safety rules; an intent-to-settings cheat sheet (warmer, more contrast without crushing blacks, matte, teal-orange, skin, ...).
- [Settings reference](docs/ai/settings-reference.md): every Camera Raw setting with its range, default, render status and meaning. Generated by `amb settings reference` (`--json` for machine-readable output).
- [Layouts and themes](docs/ai/ui-layouts.md): the JSON formats for editor layouts (panels, toolbar, knob/bar/slider controls) and themes (colour tokens), where to put them, and `ambrotype --check-look` to validate.
- [Plugins](docs/ai/plugins.md): writing a plugin (Rust to WebAssembly, sandboxed: settings in, edit commands out), its plugin.json, `amb plugin new/build/check/run`, and sharing it as a pull request.
- [Film recipes](docs/ai/film-recipes.md): the Film recipe plugin, typing in a camera film recipe, and which of our looks is closest to each camera style.
- Protocol JSON Schema: run `amb protocol schema` (commands: set_param, adjust_param, reset_param, reset_group, apply_preset, undo, redo; queries: get_param, list_params, describe, list_groups).

## Design and background

- [Transform design](docs/design/transform.md): the Transform sliders and Upright, our models, where they sit in the pipeline.
- [Spot removal design](docs/design/spot-removal.md): Lightroom's retouch tags, heal and clone, the donor search, the spot commands.
- [Masks design](docs/design/masks.md): Lightroom's mask tags, how masks are drawn and rendered, the mask commands.
- [Releasing](docs/releasing.md): the installer workflow, what each installer contains, signing.
- [MCP server](docs/ai/mcp.md): `amb mcp`, its tools and how to connect Claude Desktop or Claude Code.
- [AI-control design](docs/design/ai-control.md): why and how AI drives the app (protocol, MCP plan, look matching, safety rules).
- [Project scope](docs/SCOPE.md): goals, architecture, roadmap.

## Optional

- [Lightroom calibration plan](docs/lightroom-trial-plan.md): how the engine's models are being fitted against Lightroom renders.
